_source: Transcribed 2026-10-08 from the existing Python pipeline (read-only use): `python -m freight_recovery.cli --perspective shipper tests/fixtures/ld5002/*.csv` (run via freight_recovery.pipeline.run_pipeline to obtain JSON). From the shipper perspective the pipeline reports NO recoverable findings (its only finding, DET-UNBILLED $162.50, is carrier-direction and therefore excluded from the shipper packet), so this packet has zero findings and zero totals; the draft letter and disclaimer are copied verbatim. sha256/sizeBytes are of the git blob content (LF line endings). The rules are NOT ported or called at runtime.
verifierNote: Synthetic seed: carrier-direction detention excluded from the shipper view; review perspective.
disclaimer: MVP / pre-product output. Extracted values and calculations are unverified against real customer data and must be reviewed by a person before any dispute is sent. This is not legal or financial advice.
